banks.account: 个人借记卡（人民币个人活期存款账户）

note: Bank of China's notice of 25 January 2022: from 1 February 2022 it charges no annual fee on personal debit cards and no small-balance management fee on personal renminbi current accounts. Its later notice adjusting some personal service charges (effective 11 November 2026) wasn't read. Read 2026-10-30: Bank of China's renminbi deposit-rate table of 20 May 2025, the latest in its list: a demand (current) deposit pays 0.05% a year. Not stated: the account's other terms (the notice of fee changes from 11 November 2026 wasn't read).

sources.title: 中国银行, 关于取消个人借记卡年费和小额账户管理费的公告(2022年2月1日起)
sources.said: 我行自2022年2月1日起取消个人借记卡年费和人民币个人小额活期存款账户管理费（简称“小额账户管理费”），您名下中国银行所有个人借记卡年费（含以往年度欠缴的年费）和小额账户管理费当日起不再收取。
